title: Esses channel aliases (aliases-1)
description: <Project>/channels/aliases.json (02 sections 4.6 and 6.3, D-013): names that resolve to the first usable of an ordered list of candidates, each with its own enable flag ("enabled" has one flag per candidate, all enabled when absent; the lengths are checked by the loader), with the alias's own colour index and decimals. Names compare case-insensitively and are unique (checked by the loader). Unknown top-level members are allowed and preserved; alias records are closed.

$schema.description: Schema id (D-072). The urn:esses: form is written; the bare esses: form of earlier drafts and the later https form are accepted on load and normalised on save (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

schemaVersion.description: Minor version within major 1 (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

candidates.description: Channel or alias names, tried in order.

colourIndex.description: Index into the scheme's channel palette.

legacyBag.description: Fields removed by a migration, kept verbatim (02 section 6.6 rule 3).
